title: The Disappearance of a Saudi Journalist

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin, and I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，你每天晚上都要带着你最珍视的300件宝贝去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 然后把DJ台变成一个活生生的、快闪式的博物馆，里面陈列着精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia's crown prince has promoted himself to the West as a reformer determined to create a more free and open society.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯王储一直向西方标榜自己是一位决心创造一个更自由、更开放社会的改革者。

sentences.en: How the disappearance of a journalist in Turkey is unraveling that image.
sentences.zh: 一位记者在土耳其的失踪是如何让这一形象土崩瓦解的。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, October 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月11日，星期四。

sentences.en: Okay, so it was midday on Tuesday, October the 2nd.
sentences.zh: 事情发生在10月2日，星期二的中午。

sentences.en: It's a leafy residential district in Istanbul, where some of the consulates are, and there's some nice hotels.
sentences.zh: 那是伊斯坦布尔一个绿树成荫的住宅区，那里有一些领事馆和不错的酒店。

sentences.en: And this couple turns up at the Saudi Arabian consulate.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣出现在沙特阿拉伯领事馆。

sentences.en: And the gentleman went in, and his fiancée, who's Turkish, stayed on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 男士走了进去，而他的未婚妻——一位土耳其人——留在了人行道上。

sentences.en: He handed both his cell phones to her, and he's going in to pick up a document so that they can get married.
sentences.zh: 他把两部手机都交给了她，他进去是为了领取一份结婚所需的文件。

sentences.en: Carlotta Gall is the Istanbul bureau chief for The Times.
sentences.zh: 卡洛塔·加尔是《纽约时报》伊斯坦布尔分社社长。

sentences.en: So this was a Saudi citizen.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一位沙特公民。

sentences.en: He turned out to be someone that a lot of us knew.
sentences.zh: 结果发现他还是我们许多人都认识的人。

sentences.en: It was Jamal Khashoggi, a famous veteran journalist covering the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 他就是贾迈勒·卡舒吉，一位报道中东问题的著名资深记者。

sentences.en: He's known for being a journalist for over 30 years from Saudi Arabia, but also being very well connected with the government and the royal family.
sentences.zh: 他作为沙特记者成名已超过30年，同时也与政府和王室有着非常深厚的联系。

sentences.en: So he worked as an advisor to Prince Turkey, Bin Faisal, who was the ambassador first in London and then Washington.
sentences.zh: 他曾担任图尔基·本·费萨尔亲王的顾问，这位亲王曾先后担任驻伦敦和华盛顿的大使。

sentences.en: And then in Washington, he was literally a spokesman for the embassy.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿期间，他实际上就是大使馆的发言人。

sentences.en: He was somebody people could call.
sentences.zh: 他是人们可以联系到的人。

sentences.en: So that's how professionally he became both a journalist, but also someone very hooked in to help explain this obscure world of the kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 所以，他就是这样在职业生涯中既成为了一名记者，又成为了一个能帮助外界解读沙特阿拉伯这个神秘王国的人。

sentences.en: So it sounds like he occupied this space that doesn't really exist in the U.S., which is to be a loyalist to the Saudi government,
sentences.zh: 听起来他占据了一个在美国并不真正存在的空间，既是沙特政府的忠诚拥护者，

sentences.en: as well as a respected journalist covering it and explaining it to the outside world.
sentences.zh: 同时也是一位受人尊敬的、负责报道并向外界解释沙特情况的记者。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's what you see in many of the countries that I follow and live in, in countries that aren't fully democratic.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为在许多我关注和居住的非完全民主国家中，你都能看到这种情况。

sentences.en: I think in those societies, you can be both.
sentences.zh: 我认为在那些社会里，你可以两者兼顾。

sentences.en: And so he was very useful to both his country, but also to many others to understand events of the Middle East and of Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 因此，他不仅对自己的国家，而且对许多其他想要了解中东和沙特阿拉伯事件的人来说，都非常有价值。

sentences.en: Change is coming to a kingdom once stuck firmly in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 变革正在降临到一个曾经深陷过去的王国。

sentences.en: So then we have new developments in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们来看看沙特阿拉伯的新动态。

sentences.en: The new crown prince of Saudi Arabia is ushering in a wave of cultural change.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯的新王储正在掀起一股文化变革的浪潮。

sentences.en: We have Prince Mohammed bin Salman becoming the power in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼亲王正在成为沙特阿拉伯的实权人物。

sentences.en: His father is the king, but he's the power behind the throne.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是国王，但他才是王权背后的真正掌权者。

sentences.en: He's young, he's ambitious, and he's keen to enact reforms and bring changes to Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 他年轻、雄心勃勃，热衷于推行改革并为沙特阿拉伯带来改变。

sentences.en: Women will soon be allowed to drive, and the dreaded religious police are being reined in.
sentences.zh: 女性很快将被允许开车，令人恐惧的宗教警察也受到了约束。

sentences.en: He's allowing women into sports stadiums for the first time, and a stampede of Saudi women is now joining the workforce.
sentences.zh: 他首次允许女性进入体育场，大批沙特女性现在正涌入职场。

sentences.en: The prince said the country has become addicted to oil, and that a small part of the state-owned oil giant Aramco will be privatized.
sentences.zh: 王储表示，国家已经对石油产生了依赖，国有石油巨头阿美公司的一小部分股份将被私有化。

sentences.en: And this is embraced by many people, many people in the West, but also by Jamal Khashoggi.
sentences.zh: 这一点受到了许多人、许多西方人的欢迎，也受到了贾迈勒·卡舒吉的欢迎。

sentences.en: He is doing the most greatest favor for us in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 他正在为我们沙特阿拉伯做一件最伟大的善事。

sentences.en: Number one, he is announcing a bridge on corruption.
sentences.zh: 第一，他正在宣布一场反腐运动。

sentences.en: That is huge.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: But steadily over time, and particularly in the last year, Jamal started to have concerns.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，特别是在过去一年里，贾迈勒开始产生担忧。

sentences.en: It's been called Saudi Arabia's Game of Thrones.
sentences.zh: 这被称为沙特阿拉伯的《权力的游戏》。

sentences.en: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia has arrested dozens of top officials, from princes to ministers to officials in the armed forces.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯王国逮捕了数十名高层官员，从亲王到部长，再到武装部队官员。

sentences.en: Dissent is silenced.
sentences.zh: 异见被噤声。

sentences.en: Calls for change are censored.
sentences.zh: 变革的呼声被审查。

sentences.en: And even messages on social media can invite imprisonment and punishment.
sentences.zh: 甚至社交媒体上的信息也可能招致监禁和惩罚。

sentences.en: Free speech has come under increasing attack ever since Mohammed bin Salman took over as the crown prince last year.
sentences.zh: 自穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼去年担任王储以来，言论自由一直受到越来越多的攻击。

sentences.en: Several Muslim preachers are in prison.
sentences.zh: 几位穆斯林传教士被关进了监狱。

sentences.en: Mohammed bin Salman jailed senior members of the royal family, businessmen, and government officials on corruption charges.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼以腐败罪名监禁了王室高级成员、商人和政府官员。

sentences.en: But the sweeping campaign of arrests spread to outspoken reformers, clerics, and human rights activists.
sentences.zh: 但这场大规模的逮捕行动蔓延到了直言不讳的改革者、神职人员和人权活动人士身上。

sentences.en: And so last year, he left the country and went into self-imposed exile in Washington.
sentences.zh: 所以去年，他离开了这个国家，在华盛顿开始了自我流放。

sentences.en: And then what we saw was his columns, which he wrote for the global section of the Washington Post, became increasingly critical of the prince.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到，他为《华盛顿邮报》全球版撰写的专栏文章，对王储的批评越来越尖锐。

sentences.en: He has control of everything.
sentences.zh: 他控制了一切。

sentences.en: He is creating an environment of intimidation and fear.
sentences.zh: 他正在制造一种恐吓和恐惧的环境。

sentences.en: Saudis are being silenced.
sentences.zh: 沙特人正在被噤声。

sentences.en: As we speak today, there are Saudi intellectuals and journalists jailed.
sentences.zh: 就在我们今天谈话的时候，还有沙特知识分子和记者被关在监狱里。

sentences.en: Now nobody will dare to speak and criticize the reform they like.
sentences.zh: 现在没有人敢说话，也不敢批评他们喜欢的改革。

sentences.en: And of the reforms that he was enacting, which had their dark side, as he described it.
sentences.zh: 而他所推行的改革，正如他所描述的那样，也有其阴暗面。

sentences.en: The private companies, they were involved in corruption, but we should give them the benefit of the doubt that they had to be corrupt because the royals made them corrupt.
sentences.zh: 私营企业确实参与了腐败，但我们应该给予他们怀疑的利益，因为是王室让他们变得腐败的。

sentences.en: Those companies must survive under a new system, under a more transparent system.
sentences.zh: 这些公司必须在新的体系下，在更透明的体系下生存下去。

sentences.en: He was increasingly outspoken.
sentences.zh: 他越来越直言不讳。

sentences.en: And when he left the country and had this global platform through the Washington Post,
sentences.zh: 当他离开这个国家，并通过《华盛顿邮报》拥有了这个全球平台后，

sentences.en: I think his voice was increased enormously.
sentences.zh: 我认为他的声音被极大地放大了。

sentences.en: And that angered the government in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 这激怒了沙特政府。

sentences.en: So given all that, what was the initial suspicion about what had happened to Khashoggi when he disappeared last Tuesday inside the consulate?
sentences.zh: 那么考虑到这一切，对于上周二卡舒吉在领事馆内失踪一事，最初的怀疑是什么？

sentences.en: So the first we knew is that he didn't come out at the close of business at 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我们最早知道的是，他在下午4点下班时没有出来。

sentences.en: But the feeling was that he was inside.
sentences.zh: 但当时的感觉是他还在里面。

sentences.en: And so the first thing we did was reach his fiancée and his friends who were standing outside the consulate until 1 in the morning that night.
sentences.zh: 所以我们做的第一件事就是联系他的未婚妻和朋友，他们在那天晚上一直守在领事馆外直到凌晨1点。

sentences.en: She went to the consulate door and said, what happened?
sentences.zh: 她走到领事馆门口问，发生了什么事？

sentences.en: He didn't come out.
sentences.zh: 他没有出来。

sentences.en: And they said, we're closed.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们下班了。

sentences.en: There's no one here.
sentences.zh: 这里没有人。

sentences.en: She then called a friend of Jamal's who's in the government because he told her, if I don't come out, call this man.
sentences.zh: 她随后给贾迈勒的一位政府朋友打了电话，因为他曾告诉她：如果我没出来，就打给这个人。

sentences.en: And she called the police.
sentences.zh: 她还报了警。

sentences.en: And so for the police, at first it was a, you know, a disappeared or a missing persons.
sentences.zh: 对于警察来说，起初这只是一个失踪人口案件。

sentences.en: The Saudis came out with this comment that, oh, he left.
sentences.zh: 沙特方面出来发表评论说，哦，他离开了。

sentences.en: He left, you know, soon after he arrived.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他刚到不久就离开了。

sentences.en: In other words, he came for his meeting and he'd already left.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他是来开会的，而且已经离开了。

sentences.en: Suggesting that his fiancée could have missed him.
sentences.zh: 暗示他的未婚妻可能错过了他。

sentences.en: And the police, there were Turkish police around every consulate.
sentences.zh: 而土耳其警察在每个领事馆周围都有部署。

sentences.en: And they have their cameras.
sentences.zh: 他们有摄像头。

sentences.en: And they'd already checked the cameras.
sentences.zh: 他们已经检查了摄像头。

sentences.en: And they were adamant that he had not emerged from the consulate.
sentences.zh: 他们坚持认为他没有从领事馆出来。

sentences.en: So I think, you know, in those first hours, his friends were just going through every scenario.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，在最初的几个小时里，他的朋友们只是在推演各种可能的情况。

sentences.en: But the great question was, why would the Saudi consulate detain him, prevent him from leaving, especially at the end of their day?
sentences.zh: 但最大的问题是，沙特领事馆为什么要拘留他，阻止他离开，尤其是在他们下班的时候？

sentences.en: So then Wednesday evening, I happened to be talking to some government officials, one of whom is a security official.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，我碰巧在和一些政府官员交谈，其中一位是安全官员。

sentences.en: And of course, I asked them about this case.
sentences.zh: 当然，我问了他们关于这个案子的情况。

sentences.en: I'm working on it.
sentences.zh: 我正在处理这件事。

sentences.en: And one of them slightly casually says to me, well, he might be dead.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人随口对我说了句：嗯，他可能已经死了。

sentences.en: And although a journalist should prick their ears up, I dismissed it.
sentences.zh: 虽然记者应该对此保持警觉，但我当时没当回事。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Partly because he didn't say it as it was information that he knew.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是他说的时候并不像是在陈述他所知道的信息。

sentences.en: He was just throwing it out there as it could be, you know.
sentences.zh: 他只是随口一说，觉得有可能而已。

sentences.en: So it took a couple more days where everyone was worried about where was he.
sentences.zh: 所以又过了几天，每个人都在担心他到底在哪里。

sentences.en: And there was increasing demands to tell them about his whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 要求告知他下落的呼声越来越高。

sentences.en: And it was only by the end of that week, Friday, that we actually got Turkish officials telling us that they feared he was dead.
sentences.zh: 直到那周结束时的周五，我们才真正从土耳其官员那里得知，他们担心他已经遇害了。

sentences.en: The mystery deepens tonight over the fate of Jamal Khashoggi.
sentences.zh: 今晚，贾迈勒·卡舒吉的命运之谜愈发扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: This is a bizarre and disturbing story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个离奇且令人不安的故事。

sentences.en: His friends fear the worSt.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友们担心最坏的情况。

sentences.en: Turan Kislaki says Turkish officials told him Khashoggi was killed at the consulate.
sentences.zh: 图兰·基斯拉基说，土耳其官员告诉他，卡舒吉在领事馆内被杀害了。

sentences.en: Turkish officials have told journalists they believe Khashoggi was murdered inside the consulate.
sentences.zh: 土耳其官员告诉记者，他们认为卡舒吉在领事馆内被谋杀。

sentences.en: But so far, they've provided no evidence to back that claim up.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，他们还没有提供任何证据来支持这一说法。

sentences.en: So this was the difficulty for us reporting the story.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们报道这个故事的难处。

sentences.en: They gave us no proof.
sentences.zh: 他们没有给我们任何证据。

sentences.en: We were just relying on Turkish officials telling us things, and we couldn't firm up what they were telling us.
sentences.zh: 我们只是依赖土耳其官员告诉我们的信息，无法证实他们所说的是否属实。

sentences.en: And then after the weekend, suddenly the floodgates opened.
sentences.zh: 然后周末过后，闸门突然打开了。

sentences.en: So it turns out that two private jet planes from Saudi Arabia flew in that morning, carrying 15 Saudi officials and crew.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，两架来自沙特阿拉伯的私人喷气式飞机那天早上飞抵，载有15名沙特官员和机组人员。

sentences.en: And they arrive at different times, and they drive to the consulate, the Saudi consulate, where that same day Jamal Khashoggi went in for his meeting.
sentences.zh: 他们分批到达，并开车前往领事馆，也就是贾迈勒·卡舒吉当天去开会的那个沙特领事馆。

sentences.en: And so we've had slowly, the footage of the cars driving has been revealed, the number plates, but more important, the details of the arrival of the jets.
sentences.zh: 我们慢慢地看到了车辆行驶的录像，车牌号，但更重要的是，飞机抵达的细节。

sentences.en: And what's even more strange is that they left the same day.
sentences.zh: 更奇怪的是，他们当天就离开了。

sentences.en: So they brought in these 15 Saudi Arabians.
sentences.zh: 所以他们带来了这15名沙特人。

sentences.en: They all went to the consulate.
sentences.zh: 他们都去了领事馆。

sentences.en: They also checked into hotels.
sentences.zh: 他们还办理了酒店入住。

sentences.en: And they left the same day.
sentences.zh: 然后当天就离开了。

sentences.en: So steadily, we got more information, and it became clear that they came in two teams, and the Turkish officials started describing them as a hit squad.
sentences.zh: 随着信息的不断增加，情况变得明朗起来：他们分两组人马前来，土耳其官员开始将他们描述为行刑队。

sentences.en: They came with boxes and, you know, suitcases.
sentences.zh: 他们带着箱子，你知道，还有手提箱。

sentences.en: They also went to the bazaar and bought more suitcases on their way in.
sentences.zh: 他们在进城的路上还去了集市买了更多的手提箱。

sentences.en: And then they went into the consulate.
sentences.zh: 然后他们进了领事馆。

sentences.en: At some stage in the afternoon, they left the consulate, went to the airport, and flew away.
sentences.zh: 下午某个时候，他们离开了领事馆，去了机场，然后飞走了。

sentences.en: But there's more that's coming out.
sentences.zh: 但还有更多细节浮出水面。

sentences.en: And one of the details, which is particularly gory, is that among the equipment that the 15 Saudis brought in with them was a bone sore.
sentences.zh: 其中一个特别血腥的细节是，这15名沙特人带来的设备中包括一把骨锯。

sentences.en: So the accumulation of information is pointing to the theory put forward by some Turkish officials that he was killed within a couple of hours of entering the consulate and dismembered and taken from the consulate in suitcases or boxes that were loaded into the cars.
sentences.zh: 因此，信息的积累指向了土耳其官员提出的理论，即他在进入领事馆后的几个小时内就被杀害、肢解，并装在装进汽车的行李箱或盒子里运出了领事馆。

sentences.en: All the information that you're describing since Khashoggi disappeared inside the consulate came from the Turkish government, a government that has long had a rivalry,
sentences.zh: 你所描述的自卡舒吉在领事馆内失踪以来的所有信息都来自土耳其政府，这个政府长期以来与沙特阿拉伯存在竞争关系，

sentences.en: a complicated regional relationship with Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 以及复杂的地区关系。

sentences.en: So is there any reason to be skeptical of this account being made for what happened inside the Saudi consulate?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于这个关于沙特领事馆内发生之事的说法，有什么理由表示怀疑吗？

sentences.en: Of course, we should be skeptical and intelligence officials or security officials and diplomats we know are often careless with the truth.
